description: This file implements the core logic and command interface for 'git bisect', including setup, state management, command execution, and replaying bisect logs. It defines the 'git bisect' subcommands and manages the bisecting process within the Git codebase.

methods.name: void free_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Frees the memory allocated for bisect terms.

methods.name: void set_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * bad,const char * good)
methods.description: Sets the bad and good terms for bisecting.

methods.name: int write_terms(const char * bad,const char * good)
methods.description: Writes the bisect terms to the associated file.

methods.name: int bisect_reset(const char * commit)
methods.description: Resets the bisect state to start a new bisect session or switch to a specific commit.

methods.name: void log_commit(FILE * fp,const char * fmt,const char * state,struct commit * commit)
methods.description: Logs commit information into the bisect log.

methods.name: int bisect_write(const char * state,const char * rev,const struct bisect_terms * terms,int nolog)
methods.description: Records a bisect state change into refs and logs.

methods.name: int check_term_format(const char * term,const char * orig_term)
methods.description: Validates the format and correctness of a bisect term.

methods.name: write_terms
methods.description: Writes the current bisect terms to a file.

methods.name: int bisect_autostart(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Automatically starts bisecting if not already started.

methods.name: int decide_next(const struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * current_term,int missing_good,int missing_bad)
methods.description: Decides the next step based on current bisect status.

methods.name: void bisect_status(struct bisect_state * state,const struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Displays the current status of the bisect session.

methods.name: void bisect_print_status(const struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Prints a human-readable status of current bisect state.

methods.name: int get_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Reads the bisect terms from the file.

methods.name: int bisect_terms(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * option)
methods.description: Displays or sets bisect terms based on user input.

methods.name: int bisect_append_log_quoted(const char ** argv)
methods.description: Logs the current bisect start command with quoted arguments.

methods.name: int add_bisect_ref(const struct reference * ref,void * cb)
methods.description: Adds a referenceoid to the list of ongoing bisect refs.

methods.name: int prepare_revs(struct bisect_terms * terms,struct rev_info * revs)
methods.description: Prepares revision list for bisecting, marking bad/good commits.

methods.name: int bisect_skipped_commits(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Logs all skipped commits during bisect.

methods.name: int bisect_successful(struct bisect_terms * terms)
methods.description: Logs the first bad commit after successful bisect.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_next(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Performs the next step in the bisect process.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_auto_next(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * prefix)
methods.description: Performs automatic bisect step if not manually advanced.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_start(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Initializes and starts a new bisect session with parameters.

methods.name: int file_is_not_empty(const char * path)
methods.description: Checks if a file exists and is not empty.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_state(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Manages the bisect process state based on command arguments.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_log(void)
methods.description: Outputs the bisect log contents.

methods.name: int process_replay_line(struct bisect_terms * terms,struct strbuf * line)
methods.description: Processes a line from a bisect replay log.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_replay(struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * filename)
methods.description: Replays a bisect log file to restore state.

methods.name: enum:bisect_error bisect_skip(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Skips specified revisions during bisect.

methods.name: int bisect_visualize(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Visualizes bisect status using a graphical tool.

methods.name: int get_first_good(const struct reference * ref,void * cb_data)
methods.description: Retrieves the first good reference for bisecting.

methods.name: int do_bisect_run(const char * command)
methods.description: Runs a command as part of 'git bisect run'.

methods.name: int verify_good(const struct bisect_terms * terms,const char * command)
methods.description: Verifies the correctness of a specified 'good' revision.

methods.name: int bisect_run(struct bisect_terms * terms,int argc,const char ** argv)
methods.description: Handles the 'git bisect run' command for automated bisecting.
